items.label: Height-Adjustable
items.value: The bed support legs can set the perfect height required for the frame by rotating the base. The height of this model is at least 7.3 inches and can be adjusted up to 12 inches. When ordering, be sure to measure the gap between the top of the bed slat/bed frame and the floor and choose the size that suits you.If the size is borderline, choose the larger one.

items.label: Thickened Square Carbon Steel Pipe
items.value: The pipe diameter of the bed leg support frame is square. Compared with the circular shape, it has stronger supporting force. The carbon steel material is extremely strong and durable, ensuring that the bed legs can bear a large amount of weight without bending or breaking. Children can jump on the bed to their heart's content. At the same time, it is corrosion-resistant and will not rust even in a humid environment.

items: Non-slip Rubber Base：The enlarged and thickened rubber base of the bed leg frame provides excellent grip and stability. It can prevent the bed from sliding or shifting on the floor and ensure that the bed remains in a fixed position even when there is movement or pressure applied. At the same time, it acts as a shock absorber to reduce noise and protect the floor from scratches and damage. This is beneficial for both the bed and the surrounding area.

Installable by One Person：If there are no holes in the bed frame, a connecting strip needs to be used for installation. Pass a long screw through the included metal plate and connect to the bolt at the other end and tighten it. If the bed frame has holes, just use two screws for installation. Installation is simple and convenient to use.

items.label: Practical and Beautiful
items.value: In addition to providing additional stability for the bed, helping to evenly distribute the weight of the bed and the people on it, reducing the pressure on the bed frame and prolonging the service life of the bed frame, the adjustable bed legs can also reduce noise and provide you with a quieter sleeping environment. Moreover, the black bed legs has a simple and fashionable appearance and is suitable for different home decoration styles.

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: Adjustable bed support for heavy-duty, wooden, king or queen bed frames

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Instructions for installing the bed support legs, including the use of a connecting strip if necessary, and ensuring secure attachment to the bed frame.
